name: Neocities
line: Create and host static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript websites.

cells.regions: Global CDN (>12 data centers); no app-region choice

work.math: $5 a month. A custom domain needs the Supporter plan, though Free has 1 GB / 200 GB limits. 100 MB fits within 50 GB. Uploads under 100 MB and builds at least 10 minutes apart. Tax and the domain are extra.
Neocities has no server-side runtime for running API code.
Neocities cannot host the API and PostgreSQL deployment.
